description:
Appearance-obsessed, modern critic Dr. DokSa spreads "death rank" virus.  
If you are chosen as the most handsome man in Death Rank, you will definitely die at noon every day.  
From this incident, more and more ugly men are transformed into a society where appearance is recognized. To survive, handsome men find Dr. DokSa and form a team to get rid of the Death Rank.  
Meanwhile, Namshin (main character), who has been despised and discriminated against for his ugly appearance all his life.  
Meet the legendary plastic surgeon and be reborn as the best handsome man.  
The happy days are brief, Death Rank is announced and a mysterious man and woman appear before him.
